newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait magazine calls for Jihad against Israel.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait magazine calls for Jihad against Israel.

text.p: A Kuwaiti Islamist magazine on Monday called for Arabs to launch Jihad against Israel.

"The way of Jihad (holy war) is the only way to restore rights. Jews do not respect pledges," al-Mujtama' magazine, the mouth piece of the Social Reform Socity which is widely believed to be Kuwait's version of the s Moslem Brotherhood Movement.

"The Arab League was too late in saying its word about what is happening in Jerusalem," it said of a recommendation by Arab foreign ministers last week that member states stop normalising ties with Israel and restore their economic boycott.

"What is required of Arabs is not to stop at calling for suspension of normalisation...what is required is to severe ties with the Zionist entity and to abandon the option of negotiations that has proved its failure to all," it said.
The League's call came in response to Israel's decision to go ahead with a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
